effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] You may play 1 Digimon card with the [NSp] trait and a play cost of 7 or less from your hand without paying the cost. If DNA digivolving, you may play 2 Digimon cards with different color and the [NSp] trait and a play cost of 7 or less from your hand without paying the cost instead.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] For each of your Digimon, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP for the turn.
xros_req:
[DNA Digivolve] Green/Yellow Lv.6 + Black/Blue Lv.6 : Cost 0
Stack the 2 specified Digimon and digivolve unsuspended.
